fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You’ll find us on Lawes Street beside Australia Post East Maitland, with the Lila & Allan hair salon next door.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Parking - on-street on Lawes Street, council parking near Your Discount Chemist, and parking at the rear of the practice.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Public transport - the bus stop is directly opposite, and Victoria Street Station is a 500m walk.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Accessibility - entrance ramp, wheelchair access throughout, an accessible toilet and pram-friendly entry.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you’re in pain outside these hours, call and follow the recorded guidance. For facial swelling affecting breathing or swallowing, uncontrolled bleeding or a suspected broken jaw, call 000.
